name: DSH Token & Cost Overlay
displayName: 实时 Token 与花费悬浮窗 (Cost Overlay)

summary.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右上角实时显示当前会话的 Token 消耗、上下文缓存命中率、已节省金额、人民币花费与预算预警，并支持一键复制 Markdown 费用报告。
summary.en: Live top-right pill overlay showing real-time token consumption, context cache hit rate, cache savings, RMB cost, budget alerts, and one-click Markdown cost report export for DeepSeek Harness.

budgetYuan.description: Session cost budget threshold in CNY (¥). Set 0 to disable budget alerts.

warnThreshold.description: Fraction of budgetYuan (0-1) at which the indicator turns amber.

locale.description: Display language for the overlay pill and detail popover.
